items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses the origin of the stage name 'Peter Nero' and mentions Bette Davis, but 'Petah' is only mentioned as a correction/clarification of the name 'Peter' by the interviewer. There is no indication the interviewee knows a person named Petah.

ctx.x: Yeah. With Bernie, the question was, what kind of name can we get? Then I thought about the classic thing that everybody did in doing takeoffs on Bette Davis. They always had that line about, “Peter, Peter, come here. Peter,” and so forth.

Yeah, Petah. Bette Davis had told me that she never did a movie in her life in which there was anybody named Peter, but this is the thing everybody picked up on. But I thought, Peter Nero. This has all the sophistication that you connect with Bette Davis and show people and so forth, and it worked beautifully. So, end of story.
